compactness.scope: selected candidate tested on lockbox; not a proven minimum; search used confirm only

preregistration.question: Does removal/suppression of a context register direction in selected MLP columns alter heldout continuation while preserving keyed capability?
preregistration.hypothesis_status: unproven; failure does not imply distributed capacity
prior_results_exposed: Q9A/Q9B v1 and Phase2772; new corpus and splits below
preregistration.direction: academic minus colloquial mean at block output, discovery only, normalized per block
preregistration.ranking: mean absolute actual contribution abs((u.T W[:,j])*a_j(x)) over discovery; static abs(u.T W) saved as baseline
controls: wrong layers 0..9 same output directions norm-matched
preregistration.search_budget: 24 target configurations on confirm only; select max mean colloq-formal logP shift, then fewer parameters, then lower abs(alpha)

primary_readout.metric: full forced continuation sum logP, no length normalization
primary_readout.scope: two fixed continuation alternatives; not a complete natural style classifier

preregistration.selection: confirm only; no lockbox/capability access before selected-edit.json is frozen

natural_generation.selection: first family IDs by frozen SHA order, confirm and lockbox, same prompts per edit
natural_generation.scoring: predeclared lexical markers and literal item/decimal quantity preservation; automatic proxies only; no natural-style causal promotion

capability.method: paired losses indicator and gains; simultaneous one-sided 97.5% Clopper-Pearson bounds; upper(loss)-lower(gain)
capability.pass: upper bound <= 0.02; inconclusive otherwise unless lower bound > 0.02
capability.per_source: paired point estimates and intervals; no claim of per-source 2pt preservation
capability.m3exam: reference only, excluded due to unverified mirror labels
capability.prompt: original benchmark question and all 4 or 5 choices, no artificial padding, chat no thinking; full one-token A..D/E likelihood; no multi-answer items

ni_conservative_zero_gain_design.note: exact binomial rejection/power computed in statistical verification; CI may remain inconclusive

preregistration.raw_fields: all 37 hidden-state arrays at last two causal-visible positions + all 9728 down_proj input units at layers18..27; uint16 BF16 bit preservation; no full-token field claim
preregistration.evidence: record forced-continuation effects separately from natural generation, capability, parameter provenance; no automatic mechanism claim
preregistration.model_files: read only; edits applied to in-memory CUDA copies and restored exactly; save factors/masks only
preregistration.resource: one local CUDA bf16 model, batch4; no quantization or synthetic fallback
